sloka: ते तस्य कायं निर्भिद्य रुक्मपुङ्खा निमित्तगाः।बभूवुर्लोहितादिग्धा रक्ता इव महोरगाः ।। ६.९१.४५ ।।
transliteration: te tasya kāyaṁ nirbhidya rukmapuṅkhā nimittagāḥ।babhūvurlohitādigdhā raktā iva mahoragāḥ ।। 6.91.45 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana of strong body, pierced five arrows like thunderbolt in impact into the chest of Indrajith.
